instrument: Floor amendments to the data center moratorium ordinance at third reading (Sept 21, 2026)
summary: Reported exception pathway: data centers of 65 MW or less may proceed if located in an industrial park or on a former industrial site, not self-generating power except emergency backup, and primarily used for data. Reported as measured in IT megawatts, excluding ancillary load serving other businesses. A further amendment bars an exempted facility from sharing a parcel or industrial park with another data center. Adopted 5-1.

source.citation: WSPA, FOX Carolina, Post and Courier, Sept 21-22, 2026

notes: Amendments were made from the floor; they are not in the Sept 18 posted packet. Already-approved Valara project unaffected. Crypto mining and ancillary IT closets reported excluded. Opposed: Coker.
confidence_note: No posted document contains the amendment language. Minutes not posted after March 2026. Settled by the enacted ordinance from the Clerk to Council or the meeting video.
